result.title: SPT-Flow: One Integration, Many Futures in Continuous-Time World Models
result.summary: Continuous-time world models generate a latent trajectory through a single ODE integration, but adding stochastic conditioning does not ensure that the model uses it. In our teacher-forced baseline, posterior means vary by only about 1% of the prior scale, and matched and swapped latents yield indistinguishable reconstruction PSNR at the reported precision. We study a supervision-shortcut hypothesis: ground-truth intermediate states can reduce the need for trajectory-associated latent information. We introduce SPT-Flow, which samples one latent per trajectory and matches a free-running ODE rollout to demonstration states at multiple readout times. Re-anchoring experiments support the proposed mechanism. On LIBERO, with both models trained for 30k optimizer steps, SPT-Flow improves best-of-10 PSNR over our retrained ODEWorld baseline by 2.0 and 2.4 dB at the mid-trajectory and final frames and reduces mean LPIPS by 23%, with comparable per-sample inference cost. The rollout control recovers most of the accuracy gain; learned latent conditioning adds diversity and best-of-K gains while reducing mean sample accuracy relative to this control. The diagnostics support trajectory-associated latent utilization; semantic mode coverage under matched conditions in the robotic setting remains unverified.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPT-Flow：在连续时间世界模型中每条轨迹采样一个 latent，将自由运行的 ODE rollout 在多个读出时刻与演示状态对齐；并用匹配/交换 latent 的诊断检验 teacher-forced 基线的 latent 条件是否真被使用，在 LIBERO 上报告 PSNR/LPIPS 提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 「监督捷径」假设与匹配/交换 latent 探针可为核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被答案使用、中间状态监督是否造成视觉旁路或信息坍缩提供线索；但研究对象是机器人世界模型，迁移性待判断。
